method_notes.description: Claude Code workflow agents (Fable 5.1, 30 parallel chunks of ~10 frames) read each decision frame's 2x-enlarged crop (x 440-840, y 120-400 of the 1280x720 frame, grid every 20 px, labels every 100 px) with the image Read tool and typed the mitt centre, the four plate corners and a +/- pixel figure; the session spot-checked a sample by drawing the points on the crops. No detector, no tracking between frames, no ground truth.

uncertainty_basis: annotator's stated +/- in original pixels for the mitt centre (v0); not measured against ground truth

annotation_elapsed.basis: workflow launch to last chunk result (file timestamps), 30 chunks run in parallel; per-frame agent time is not isolated
